title: Compliance
text: “Elephant, you’re the excellent teacher who goes around instructing Kou and the rest of the Filolial-samas in all manner of things — so tell me, what do you make of Father? If you’ve given up on him, I’ll gladly lend a hand.”
Elephant really is a fine elephant, indeed-zou. So perhaps, at a moment like this, some faint seed of romance has sprouted in her heart too, I wonder?
“Oh? Is that so, Elmelo-chan?”
Uhu~, Older Sister asked Elephant with a giggle.
“You… you always put your own business on the back burner, but the second you catch a whiff of someone else’s romance, you make the exact same face as Shield Hero-sama. What’s with that…”
“Oh myyy?”

Elephant just sighed, refusing to answer my question! And just like that, Older Sister and Panda and the rest started drifting off, clearly headed out for drinks. Ngh… everyone was being far too leisurely about this. There was no time to spare, indeed. Rival knew exactly how to crack Father, so if their paths ever crossed, Father’s virginity would be snatched away in the blink of an eye.
“There’s no time! Father’s virginity could be stolen by that thing at any moment!”
“He’s making a scene again. Should I report this to Iwatani-sama?”
Rabbit Guy muttered as he passed by, so I shot him a glare, and he snapped his face away and hurried off. That old trauma of his was clearly still acting up, I say!
“Hmm… you really hate the idea of that thing stealing Shield Hero’s virginity that much?”
And that was when a voice I did not want to hear spoke up. I turned around, and of all people, there stood Rafumi.
“I wasn’t talking to you!”
Rafumi was completely out of the question. Father himself had said his partner ought to be a proper, wholesome woman — those were his own words, indeed.
“Weren’t you the one shouting like you wanted the whole world to hear, Spear Hero? Besides, it seems Shield Hero’s having quite a time of it thanks to you, so I thought I’d step in myself.”
“What’s that supposed to mean? Do you know someone who’d make a good match for Father? Someone who could relieve him of his virginity, I mean.”
“It can’t be all that hard to relieve Shield Hero of his virginity, can it? Everyone around him is aware of him one way or another — give it a little push and it’d be easy enough.”
“Think that, and you’ll find yourself outpaced by just how stubbornly virtuous he is, indeed.”
Speaking from experience here.
“Heh… so you’ve been struggling that badly, have you? Well, as for the virgin end of things, stoking the fire ought to be easy enough as matters stand.”
“Stop talking like Rival, would you!”

Rival had originally given up on virginity and gone after maidenhood instead, but she was back to her old ways now, indeed. In my memory, Rival protested, “Nano, that’s not even what Rival was after! Nano, would you learn already!” — but I didn’t believe a word of it!
“Just the other day, I went out with Father to the red-light districts of Zeltoble and Siltvelt, and when I wouldn’t let the subject drop, I got lectured for a very, very long time.”

“Hey now, Motoyasu-kun, I don’t know exactly what you’re so worried about here, but you’re being awfully persistent, so could you please knock it off?” Father scolded me thoroughly, and even stood watch until I’d written out a proper letter of apology. Being watched like that sent a little thrill through me, but that didn’t solve the actual problem, I say.
“I see. So no matter how much you explain it, Spear Hero, he simply doesn’t grasp the gravity of the situation — is that what you’re telling me?”
“Indeed.”
Having Father’s virginity stolen by Rival would be an utter, crushing defeat for me. No matter what, I had to stop it.
“Ahh… Father, offering up your very body to Rival like that — your devotion did keep the worst outcome at bay, true enough, but still, it’s no good, I say.”
“I see. So no matter what happens, you simply can’t stand the thought of that female Gaelion stealing Shield Hero’s virginity?”
“That’s exactly what I’ve been saying.”
“Then why not let me be the one to graduate Shield Hero from his virginity?”
Rafumi said, just like that.
“What in the world are you saying!”
Of all people, you, stealing Father’s virginity — what does that even mean!
“Heh… Spear Hero. You truly can’t stand the thought of Shield Hero being taken by that female Gaelion, can you? So I’m saying I’ll take one for the team.”
“Out of the question!”
“Don’t say that. Even I have feelings where the name Gaelion is concerned. After all, that chocolate business is what led me to do all sorts of things to Shield Hero.”
That incident from Valentine’s Day back in the first world. I still remember it clearly — Father crying out for help. This Rafumi was what became of that chocolate monster, in the end.

“Spear Hero. Do you know why none of the other women ever made a move on Shield Hero, back in the world before he became a hero? It’s because he never crosses that line with anyone. He gives off an aura that makes people think, without even realizing it, ‘I can just call on him whenever I’m in trouble.’ If anything, he’s the sort of presence that keeps everyone getting along fine, precisely by making them afraid of ever changing that relationship.”
“Damn it! But Older Sister and the others are different! And Father isn’t that kind of man either!”
Depending on the loop, Older Sister and Panda have actually done it with Father! So it ought to be possible.

“Enough excuses. Spear Hero, didn’t you yourself try dragging Shield Hero off to the red-light district to get him some experience? Which means, to you, anyone but that female Gaelion is perfectly fair game — isn’t that exactly it?”
“Ngh…”
This had become a situation I couldn’t very well deny.
“Then there shouldn’t be a problem with me either, should there?”
“No! We cannot go giving Father a shock like that!”
Back in the first world, when Father nearly ended up with you, he was left in shock for quite a while. I still remember him trembling, I say!
“That was me back when I’d gone berserk — the me now would never pull off anything so unsightly. Now, now, once I’ve shown Shield Hero my masterful technique, even you’ll be satisfied.”
“That’s exactly why I keep saying you’re out of the question!”

“What is it? What don’t you like? Ah, is it this appearance? Shield Hero doesn’t care about looks, he’s the type who values what’s on the inside, isn’t he? So even someone breezy and easygoing like me ought to win him over, so long as I show a bit of affection and goodwill.”
“What you’ve got isn’t ‘breezy and easygoing,’ indeed.”
Anyone who calls themselves “breezy and easygoing” can’t be trusted, honestly.
“Father needs a big-sisterly type who’ll protect him!”
“I happen to be a guardian of love, you know?”
“That’s not at all what I meant!”
“What a selfish fellow. Well then, there shouldn’t be any problem if I go in this form.”

Poof! Rafumi suddenly transformed… into the shape of a grown-up Big Sister! Ngh… what a sight, indeed! In this loop, Big Sister was still in her young form, so having this adult version glare at me felt awfully unsettling.
“Visually speaking, this ought to be a familiar sight to you. Even Shield Hero, back in the first world, smiled when he saw this original form, didn’t he?”
“With Big Sister, it takes Father forever to get anywhere!”

I felt like, somewhere in my memories, Big Sister was making a rather pained face. It’s true that she was terribly shy when it came to Father. In the end, it took quite a long time before the two of them finally got together, indeed.

“Don’t say that. If I go at Shield Hero in this form with a proper Big-Sister routine, he’ll fall in an instant. And if I make clear I’m just disguised as her, rather than some grown version of her young self, he shouldn’t have any objections at all.”

Motoyasu, you cannot let Rafumi go through with this — not looking like that. If I let this happen, then even if I someday reunited with Father, I’d get beaten half to death by Big Sister for it — and worse, from where I stood, the very worst outcome awaited: being sent back to my own world and having every memory of this wiped clean. That sense of crisis flashed through my mind. Never mind the world — this was a crisis for me. No matter what, I had to stop this.
“No! All I can see is a future where I get erased in every possible sense! And more than that, you’ll get deleted too! Think about compliance, would youuuuu!”

I threw myself flat onto the ground and threw a full-on tantrum. A few people, hearing the commotion, came over to peek at what was going on — but the instant they laid eyes on me and Rafumi, they turned right around and left.
